findings.title: Nested <a> elements: invalid HTML and bypassed curtain transition
findings.description: HSMonogram.tsx renders its own <a href="/"> wrapper (lines ~86–98) with an onClick that calls router.push('/') directly. Nav.tsx wraps the entire branding group — HSMonogram, the laser divider, and the signature — in an outer <a href="/"> (lines ~72–96) whose onClick fires navigateTo('/', 'home') to trigger the HomePreloader curtain. Nesting <a> inside <a> is invalid per HTML spec §4.5.1; browsers close the outer anchor before the inner one opens, so the laser divider and signature fall outside the outer link. Clicks on those elements skip the curtain and do a plain href navigation. Clicks on the monogram itself call router.push('/') bypassing the curtain entirely.
findings.consequence: The HomePreloader curtain transition is never fired when navigating home by clicking any part of the branding group. The layout is structurally broken in all browsers.
findings.correction: Remove the <a> wrapper, useRouter import, and handleClick function from HSMonogram.tsx. Return only the <svg> and <style> elements. Move the .hs-monogram-link class (for hover CSS) to the outer <a> in Nav.tsx so the existing hover styles remain functional.
